title: Freestanding Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Solid Brass Weighted Base - | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your kitchen counter with a freestanding paper towel holder crafted from solid brass, featuring a weighted base for steady tear-off and a felt pad to help protect surfaces.

  • Freestanding design: no wall mounting required
  • Solid brass construction: built for everyday kitchen use
  • Weighted base: helps prevent tipping while tearing sheets
  • Felt pad: helps prevent scratching on countertops
  • Finish options: available in a wide variety of designer finishes

Specs

  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Overall size: 5-Inch L x 5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Paper towel holder
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Contemporary Counter Top Kitchen Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Complete your kitchen décor with this finely crafted counter top paper towel holder. Keep your counter top clutter free while adding the finishing touch to your space. Made of solid brass and provided with a lifetime finish to insure products will never rust.
